W1: target detected in only 2 of 8 epochs

plain: It moves across the sky: about 0.22 arcseconds per year, measured over 14 years (a tentative measurement), matching the catalog proper motion.
Its infrared colour W1-W2 = at least 2.6 mag is very red, like T-type brown dwarfs.
Too few WISE measurements to tell whether its brightness changes.
Its SPHEREx spectrum fits a T8 brown-dwarf template best; the next best (d_sdT8) fits about as well.
